170.description: This vector is related to sub-word tokens and character combinations typical of the Devanagari script.

123.description: This vector activates on various forms of the Hindi vowel 'i' (इ/ई) and its associated dependent vowel sign (matra ⁠ि) across different scripts and encodings.

113.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel sign combinations and diphthongs used in character-level text representation.

114.description: This vector represents fragments of Hindi text, particularly consisting of dependent vowel signs, consonants, and common word endings.

116.description: This vector represents Hindi pronouns, adjectives, and quantifier words related to quantity, selection, or distinction.

65.description: These tokens primarily represent fragments of Hindi text written in the Devanagari script, alongside minor artifacts and encoding noise.

15.description: This feature vector activates on non-English script fragments, punctuation marks, and subword suffixes from various multilingual and programming contexts.

196.description: This vector activates strongly on the Hindi letter 'अ' and its various conjuncts, vowels, and phonetic variations.

17.description: This vector represents common Hindi conjunct consonants formed with the anusvara (dot nasal) diacritic.

115.description: This feature vector represents first- and second-person pronouns, primarily in Hindi and Greek script fragments.
